mappings.description:
List of RBD image mappings to configure for this instance/service block. Each item represents a single `rbd-nbd map` invocation context within this config file (if the format supports multiple entries, otherwise only the first is used, but for template generality, we list them). Note: Standard rbd-nbd config files often just pass command line args. This template assumes a wrapper script or config reader that parses these blocks. If single-use, list length 1 is expected.
Items schema:
- pool: string
- image: string
- snap_id: number (optional)
- read_only: bool (optional, overrides global)
- exclusive: bool (optional, overrides global)
- notrim: bool (optional, overrides global)
- io_timeout: number (optional, overrides global)
- reattach_timeout: number (optional, overrides global)
- encryption_format: string (optional, overrides global)
- encryption_passphrase_file: string (optional, overrides global)
- device: string/number (optional, explicit device index)

mappings_items.description: Fields for each item in the mappings list.
